smokeScope: CI SDK/native artifacts from testedCommit (run 35244272419: android-aar and native-android, identical .so sha256 per ABI, and identical again inside the harness APK; arm64-v8a af1829724b16c458e577505bf3eea2f3a08951965f5d0c901bf8e7079e7691ef, armeabi-v7a bc4762486ce229552f7163b6dcf8212077e35cd226461c444056bb6fbbcf0784; both .so contain the new literal "Beam recovery stalled: fewer than two nodes qualify for the quorum", which the v0.1.4 artifacts of run 35194786362 do not, so the patch-0018 build is distinguishable even though coreCommit and nativeVersion are unchanged) in an isolated Testnet sample with a random seed and no INTERNET permission: create, cold reopen, PublicOffline receive token, stateless token parser, unfunded offline quote rejected; no network start or send. The two ABIs used separate runIds (35244272419 and 35244272419-v7a) because the harness namespaces its phase state by runId alone, so a shared runId would start the second ABI at the reopen phase. Network behaviour is covered separately, off-device: MainnetSnapshotRestoreLiveTest ran against a locally built dylib of the same source at 2026-09-17T16:19:42Z with the quorum off and reached Ready on mainnet in 29s at height 4041199 with quorumRequests=0 and no failure; the snapshot landed at the tip, so that run observed no separate body-scan advances and the assertion was satisfied by Ready, not by an advance count. The same run wrote logs/beam_26_09_17_23_19_43.log, whose 10 lines are all Info even though the configured level was Debug, confirming that a Release-built native compiles BEAM_LOG_DEBUG to a stub. The deadlock this release fixes was reproduced on the Pixel 6 with the previous v0.1.4 build the same day: currentHeight frozen at 4040837 from 17:25 to 17:57 local while the tip advanced 4040843 -> 4040879 and syncTotal grew 13 -> 76. Whether the fix clears that on the device is proven only by the P.CASH build that consumes this release, not by this harness.
